speaker: Samantha
text: Okay, let's get started, we have a lot to cover and only thirty minutes.

speaker: Samantha
text: First item is the release plan for the new version of the app.

speaker: Samantha
text: After yesterday's review, the launch date moved to the twentieth of March.

speaker: Daniel
text: That works for engineering, but only if we fix the crash first.

speaker: Samantha
text: Right, can you give us an update on that?

speaker: Daniel
text: Sure. The crash happens only on older tablets, when the app is resumed from the background.

speaker: Daniel
text: We can reproduce it now, and I expect a fix by the end of the week.

speaker: Karen
text: Is it affecting many users?

speaker: Daniel
text: About two percent of sessions, mostly in schools that use older devices.

speaker: Karen
text: Then we should mention it in the release notes either way.

speaker: Samantha
text: Agreed. Next, the feature everyone keeps asking about.

speaker: Samantha
text: We are going to call the new feature Quick Share, and it lets people send a list to a friend in one tap.

speaker: Karen
text: Marketing likes the name, so no objections from us.

speaker: Karen
text: But I have some less good news about our side.

speaker: Karen
text: The marketing budget for the spring campaign is cut by fifteen percent.

speaker: Karen
text: So we will focus on social media and drop the printed posters.

speaker: Samantha
text: That is a shame, but it makes sense.

speaker: Daniel
text: On the infrastructure side, the backend migration to the new database finishes next Tuesday.

speaker: Daniel
text: There will be a short maintenance window at night, around one hour.

speaker: Samantha
text: Please post the exact time in the channel once you know it.

speaker: Daniel
text: Will do. And one good number to share, page load time is now one point two seconds on average.

speaker: Karen
text: That is a big improvement, we can use it in the campaign.

speaker: Karen
text: We also finished the user survey last week.

speaker: Karen
text: The feature people want most is a dark mode, by a wide margin.

speaker: Samantha
text: Interesting, let's put that on the roadmap for the summer.

speaker: Samantha
text: On staffing, we will hire two more designers in January.

speaker: Samantha
text: The job posts go out next week, so please share them with anyone you know.

speaker: Karen
text: One more thing from me, the customer advisory board meets in Lisbon this year.

speaker: Karen
text: Two of us will travel, and we will report back afterwards.

speaker: Samantha
text: Great. Last point, the next meeting is moved to Thursday afternoon because of the public holiday.

speaker: Daniel
text: Thursday is fine for me.

speaker: Karen
text: For me too.

speaker: Samantha
text: Perfect, thanks everyone, that's all for today.
